evidence.detail: When objects array is empty, Table renders with empty tbody and pagination showing '0-0 of 0' — no dedicated empty-state message
Every achievement with a legend unconditionally renders {{> livedecktable}} which triggers an AJAX request even when there are no decks
The person page already gates deck sections with {{#has_decks}}; person_achievements does not have equivalent gating
Person view sets has_decks = len(person.decks) > 0 — the server-side pattern exists but is not applied to achievement detail tables

triage.notes: Two approaches exist: add a client-side empty state to Table/DataManager (simplest, single JS change but still makes the AJAX request), or determine server-side whether each achievement detail has decks and skip rendering the table div. The second requires deciding across multiple affected views.
